_comment: PorchRokr 2026 festival data, transcribed from the official brochure (page 1 schedule + map, 400dpi) via outputs/porchrokr/porch-table.md and lineup-2026.json. Porches 32-37 carry Nominatim geocodes; every other porch and all stages carry map-derived coords (brochure-map-affine-fit anchored on porches 32/33/34/35), reviewed and approved by Byron on 2026-08-09. Where street is null the printed street text was unreadable or unconfirmed; the coords are authoritative there and houseNumber is kept for reference only. Consumed by scripts/import-porchrokr.js; see the 2026-08-09 PorchRokr ADR.

festival.name: PorchRokr Music & Arts Festival
festival.logistics: Porch sets run 11:00 AM to 6:30 PM: odd-numbered porches at 11:00, 1:00, 3:00, and 5:00; even-numbered porches at 12:00, 2:00, 4:00, and 6:00 (30-minute sets). Headliner Rent for Cheryl closes the festival at 7:30 PM on the Main Stage. Fixed stages: the Main Stage, the Yellow Brick Road Stage on W. Exchange St, and the Beer Garden & Stage on the Augusta Ave edge of Will Christy Park. Will Christy Park also hosts the Kid Zone, karaoke, the silent auction, and the silent disco. Porches 38 and 39 are inside House Three Thirty (532 W. Market St). FREE Park & Ride shuttle from the APS lot at the corner of N. Main St & W. Market St.

porches.notes: Porch 1 IS the Main Stage; its acts route to the Main Stage venue and the headliner closes there. Printed house number 88 kept for reference; street unconfirmed. Coords map-derived, reviewed by Byron.
